question: Can an already demonstrated conditional carrier write a distinct, quiet terminal clock record after an earlier writer has also crossed the receiver?
claim: A finite prepared two-clock conditional-carrier and terminal-record composition. This is not autonomous trial generation, activation from rest, unique physical routing, complexity preference or physical light.

primary_acceptance: All four masks are complete and pass immutable footprint equality, initial boundary margin, no active boundary contact, source input presence, both clock null orbits and both early/late carrier-plus-C truth tables. Every mask has a quiet terminal receiver. Joint11 full336 receiver state must differ from each00,10,01 at every terminal-hold state, with a fixed nonzero relative center phase against each. The same registered receiver phase must pass on both sizes. This is stronger than11 versus writer-only. A record aliasing the initial/null phase fails.

A weaker writer-armed comparison is not a terminal detector and never promotes a failed primary result. Early reflected waves and later feedback remain in the native state.

budget_scope: Whole dedicated CLI process: wrapper CPU plus child user/system CPU, including imports, preflight, assembly, capture, inverses, passive observation, compression, export and archive hashing.
